patterns.note: Full-width sections with distinct background colors or patterns create clear visual breaks and define content areas.
A vibrant, almost neon green is used as a primary accent color for buttons, icons, and background patterns, providing high contrast.
A monospace font (Geist Mono) is consistently used for metadata, labels, and small informational text, contrasting with the main sans-serif typography.
A repeating pixelated grid pattern is used as a background texture in several sections, adding a digital and structured aesthetic.
No scroll-triggered motion; elements simply appear as they enter the viewport without animation.

technique_notes: Sections are defined by full-width background colors or patterns, creating clear visual separation. Content within these sections is typically centered or aligned to a grid.
A distinct pixelated grid pattern is applied as a background texture to certain sections, giving a digital and structured feel.
Typography uses a primary sans-serif for headings and body, complemented by a monospace font for all small informational labels and metadata, creating a technical yet readable hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) are paired with smaller, often uppercase monospace labels for metadata, creating a clear informational hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used throughout for buttons, cards, and section edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing overall, with airy sections in the hero and footer, and a tighter grid for news articles.

standout: The distinctive use of a bright, almost neon green combined with a pixelated grid pattern creates a unique digital and technical aesthetic. The consistent application of a monospace font for all metadata and labels further reinforces this tech-forward, data-oriented brand identity, making it feel less like a generic marketing site and more like a specialized tool.
